name: continuwuity
title: Continuwuity
description: A Matrix homeserver in one container, with its own database: your own chat server that federates with every other Matrix server.
notes: Your Matrix IDs end in :{{server_name}}, for good: that name can't change later. The server answers at https://{{domain}}. If {{server_name}} isn't {{domain}}, the site at https://{{server_name}} must serve two files so other servers and apps find this one: /.well-known/matrix/server with {"m.server": "{{domain}}:443"}, and /.well-known/matrix/client with {"m.homeserver": {"base_url": "https://{{domain}}"}}, both as application/json, the client one also with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. First account: on its first start the server writes a one-time registration token to its log; open the app's Logs, find the line that says "using the registration token", then register in a Matrix client (Element, Cinny) against https://{{domain}} with that token. Nobody else can sign up: more accounts are made from the admin room. Check federation at https://federationtester.matrix.org with {{server_name}}. Everything it keeps is on one volume, which Caravana backs up every day at 03:00 UTC (the server stops for a few seconds). Voice and video calls aren't set up: they need a TURN server.
